answer.reason: The verses tell of Gomorrah's defeat in battle and of its overthrow by fire from the LORD, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was overthrown when the LORD rained brimstone and fire on it from heaven
clauses.quote: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

clauses.english: saw its king flee and fall in battle, and its goods were taken by Chedorlaomer and his allies
clauses.quote: the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there

doubts: Later verses (Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Amos, Zephaniah, Matthew, Mark, Romans, 2 Peter, Jude) use Gomorrah only as a comparison or example, so they were not used.
GEN 18:20 (the cry of its grievous sin) was left out as a statement about the LORD's intent, not an event.
